questions.topic: PrepLadder · 26.Adverse Drug Reactions, Pediatric Dermatoses, Urticaria and Angioedema
questions.stem: A 25-year-old man presents with recurrent dark red plaques on his penis. He reports that these lesions appear shortly after taking certain medications. The patches are localized and recur in the same areas with each exposure. He denies any other symptoms or systemic involvement. Which of the following statements is correct regarding the diagnosis?

options.label: A
options.text: Resolution of lesions without any visible skin lesions.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a type 1 hypersensitivity reaction

options.label: C
options.text: Upon re-exposure Lesions develop on the 10th day.

options.label: D
options.text: Tetracyclines are commonly associated with FDE
